elements.note: Plan of the laundry/kitchen terrace with the railing on two sides, plus the side steps down to ground at +0.25 / +0.10 / +0.00.
The 2.70 m end face including the steps. Rail divisions marked EQ1 -- a different EQ label from the EQ used on รูปด้าน 2, so the two faces are set out independently.

warnings: Railing TYPE 2, called out from the ground-floor plan A-05. It guards the laundry/kitchen terrace on the east side at +0.38.

*** THE TWO RAILING TYPES ARE DIFFERENT MATERIALS, AND THIS ONE MATCHES THE STAIR AND RAMP. *** Railing 2 is STAINLESS (ø 1 1/2" handrail and stanchions, ø 1" intermediate rails) exactly like the ST-1 balustrade on A-17 and the ramp on A-19. Railing 1 on A-20 is PAINTED STEEL BOX (2"x4" and 1"x2" RHS). So the odd one out is railing 1, upstairs; everything at ground level is stainless.
Both types are 0.90 m high, but the rail arrangement differs: type 1 has four rails at an even 0.20 m; type 2 has three at 0.20 m then a wider 0.30 m gap at the bottom.

POST SPACING IS AGAIN LEFT AS 'EQ' on the long faces, and the two elevations use DIFFERENT labels -- EQ1 on รูปด้าน 1 and EQ on รูปด้าน 2 -- so the two faces are set out independently and a take-off cannot assume a common pitch.
The side steps down from the terrace are dimensioned here: rises of 0.10 / 0.15 / 0.13 giving levels +0.10 / +0.25 / +0.38, matching the step chain shown on the site plan and A-05.
